about.content:
Independent news publication based in New Delhi, India. Formerly student-run.

The Voice Express was founded in 2022 as an Intro to New Media project that refused to stay one. We started because none of the seven journalism departments in the University of Delhi had their own publication. We stayed because the absence we were trying to fill turned out to be larger than we thought.

We cover the stories that fall through institutional cracks — labour, state violence, student life, protest, culture, and whatever else needs to be said. We do not take advertising. We do not answer to institutions.

After all, the truth takes time.

Our Team

submissions.content:
We accept submissions all year round. Carefully read the classification criteria & additional guidelines of all categories to ensure that your submission is relevant, & please limit submissions to one at a time per category. All submissions are to be made via e-mail as a .docx (Word file) attachment to thevoiceexpress@proton.me with ‘[INSERT CATEGORY] SUBMISSION’ as the subject. Please include a brief third-person bio (authors/whistleblowers concerned about identity may request anonymity).

Guidelines

Formatting

Standard margins, Times New Roman 12pt, double-spaced. The document should contain in order: 1) A title page (title, author(s), completion date, brief description). 2) The article, centred bold title. 3) References with working URLs. 4) Appendix of documentary or photographic material.

Categories

  1. Whistleblower: Verified submissions go directly into our News Feed. If it should be out there, we’ll publish it.
  2. Opinion: Logical substantiation required. 1,000–2,000 words.
  3. Editorials: Essays 1,500–5,000 words. Experimental writing encouraged. No fiction or poetry.
  4. Pictured: Photo stories. Minimum 3 photographs, at least 1080px on shortest side. Accompanying text optional, max 500 words.
